title: Eclectus Industries
description: Add machines to Minecraft using Vanilla Block such as cobblestone drills
body:
**Eclectus Industries**

This plugin add custom machines based on vanilla blocks.
They can be used to make your server live an industrial revolution 
using custom machinerie. You can use the machinerie to make new 
more efficient farms without mods.

It currently adds the following machines:
- Drills
